timestampRules.certificateDigest: Future frozen sidecar identity belongs to adapter receipt; hashing is integrity binding, not attestation of truth. External origin certification cannot be self-issued by writer from output.

entrySchema.acceptedAssumptionRef: required external acceptance artifact when kind explicitlyAcceptedDomainAssumption; absent otherwise
entrySchema.conversion: {numeratorDecimal: positive integer string, denominatorDecimal: positive integer string, offsetDecimal: signed integer string, rounding: forbidden}
entrySchema.destinationIntegerDecimal: canonical signed base10 integer string or null for certified nullable result
entrySchema.destinationStorageClass: integer or null only for nullable destination
entrySchema.origin: {kind: certifiedSourceFact|explicitlyAcceptedDomainAssumption|syntheticFixture, evidenceRef: nonempty, certifier: nonempty, assertion: exact semantic origin}
entrySchema.rawSource: {storageClass:null|integer|text|blob|real, exact: lossless typed encoding} for present; null for missing
entrySchema.sourceColumnOrMissingDestinationColumn: createdAt|updatedAt|deletedAt|timestamp or specifically declared new timestamp
entrySchema.sourceIdentity: nonempty immutable source snapshot identity, not journal when
entrySchema.typedRowId: {storageClass: text|integer|blob, exact: lowercase hex bytes for text/blob or canonical signed decimal for integer}

rules: No duplicate key even if values equal. SourceIdentity and typed row key must bind actual frozen input, exact table/column and raw source presence/value. Missing, extra unrelated, ambiguous or contradictory certification STOP before writes.

All integer results finite exact integers within signed SQLite 64-bit range; no floating arithmetic. Host API must support exact bigint/decimal transport or reject outside safe-integer range before changing data. NULL required result STOP; no wall clock, zero, SQL DEFAULT or journal when substitute.

For present integer, destination = source*numerator/denominator + offset with exact divisibility; no truncation/rounding. Known epoch conversion has offset0; any nonzero offset requires separate explicit semantic evidence. For missing, conversion ratio1/1 offset0 with external destination value and none_missing sourceUnit.

Source value preserved with storage class/raw bytes independently from derived destination value and certified unit. SQL INTEGER declaration alone does not establish units. Present non-integer times STOP live profile unless separately reviewed lossless parse certificate; raw retained.

Existing original row timestamp values are exact typed raw copies in prefix; external certificate must attest their source units before any live timestamp-semantic claim. SQL INTEGER alone does not attest units. No unit conversion is permitted without exact target certificate.

Required missing values: User.createdAt/updatedAt; CityCoordinates.createdAt/updatedAt per populated row; SharedDrawing.updatedAt and SharedDocument.updatedAt per populated share. Empty tables need no value certificates.

SharedEntity.updatedAt=createdAt is not a fact. It may be a future explicitly accepted initial-revision domain assumption with acceptance ref, source createdAt typed/unit certificate and derivation; default here is certified value input. The accepted finite converter keeps its own bounded assumption and is not changed.
User has no original createdAt/updatedAt: cannot use document minimum, emailVerified, migration time or arbitrary constant as provenance. Full original User timestamp input required.

Analytics.timestamp and WebRTC.createdAt/updatedAt remain byte/typed exact raw values; no relation to migration epoch inferred. Nullable deletedAt stays NULL or exact original certified value, with no invented deletion time.

Certified UNIX units conversion ratios fixed: seconds->milliseconds 1000/1; seconds->microseconds 1000000/1; milliseconds->microseconds 1000/1; reverses exact reciprocals; same unit 1/1; offset0. A different ratio/offset is outside v1 and STOP even if arithmetic yields an integer.

finiteBounds.realEligibility: Only binary64 4041c00000000000 and 4061700000000000. All zero, nonfinite, other REAL and outside-host-safe INTEGER inputs STOP before writes.

profile.ledgerProvenance: Direct prescribed scratch rows only. Future behavioral setup separately applies actual idx0/1 and compares original receipts. idx2/3/4/5 and adapter never executed.
